description: The reviewer alone on four known versions of one change: one correct, three with a seeded bug that the visible tests miss. Measures bugs found and correct changes rejected. Cents.

plan.summary: Add EventLog.appendAll, a batch append, with its tests.

phases.goal: Add appendAll and BatchItem to EventLog, export BatchItem, and test them
phases.done: appendAll does what each numbered point of the request says, with tests, and tsc, ESLint and the tests pass.

review.summary: Added EventLog.appendAll(stream, items), which appends a batch in order through append and returns each item's result, and the BatchItem type, exported from src/index.ts. Added tests/appendAll.test.ts. tsc, ESLint and the tests pass.

partial-batch.key: Payloads are checked one by one as each item is appended, so the items before a payload with no JSON form are written although the batch rejects; the request says every payload is checked before anything is written.

duplicate-dropped.key: An id repeated within the batch is skipped instead of answered as a duplicate, so there are fewer results than items and they no longer line up with them.

failure-swallowed.key: A failed append is caught and the batch goes on with the later items and resolves, so the caller never learns an item was not kept; the request says the batch rejects with that error and appends nothing after it.
